1.explanation:
1. OverflowMenu/README.md – describes the component’s API, default styling, and any documented modifiers.  
2. OverflowMenu/migrate-to-7.x.md – shows migration notes and any prior discussion of modifiers; it may reference light-theming support (or the lack thereof).  
3. OverflowMenuItem/migrate-to-7.x.md – covers the menu item subcomponent’s styling and any theme hooks or modifiers that affect item backgrounds, text color, and separators.  
4. TextInput/README.md – includes the implementation of the `--light` modifier; reviewing how TextInput swaps backgrounds and text colors for light mode guides how to add a similar modifier to OverflowMenu.  
5. Icon/migrate-to-7.x.md – shows how the overflow (three-dot) icon is themed or restyled; understanding Icon’s light/dark handling is key to ensuring the trigger button matches the light menu variant.
1.bug_scenario: The Overflow Menu’s dropdown is displaying with a muted grey background on top of an already grey page background, and its menu items (text and separators) are similarly mid-tone grey—resulting in poor contrast and making it hard to distinguish the icon, container, and options. There is currently no “light” or high-contrast modifier for OverflowMenu as there is for other form components.
